'''''Beta macrocarpa''''', the '''large-fruited beet''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Amaranthaceae]], native to the [[Canary Islands]] and the shores of the Mediterranean.<ref name="164476-1" >{{cite POWO |id=164476-1 |title=''Beta macrocarpa'' Guss. |access-date=11 April 2022 }}</ref><ref name="commonname" >{{cite web |url=https://identify.plantnet.org/the-plant-list/species/Beta%20macrocarpa%20Guss./data |title=''Beta macrocarpa'' Guss. |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2022 |website=plantnet.org |publisher=[[Pl@ntNet]] |access-date=11 April 2022 }}</ref> It is widely used to study [[beet necrotic yellow vein virus]] in an effort to improve the [[sugar beet]].<ref name="1_of_719_Google_Scholar_results" >{{cite journal |title=Transcriptome Analysis of ''Beta macrocarpa'' and Identification of Differentially Expressed Transcripts in Response to Beet Necrotic Yellow Vein Virus Infection |year=2015 |last1=Fan |first1=Huiyan |last2=Zhang |first2=Yongliang |last3=Sun |first3=Haiwen |last4=Liu |first4=Junying |last5=Wang |first5=Ying |last6=Wang |first6=Xianbing |last7=Li |first7=Dawei |last8=Yu |first8=Jialin |last9=Han |first9=Chenggui |journal=PLOS ONE |volume=10 |issue=7 |article-number=e0132277 |doi=10.1371/journal.pone.0132277 |doi-access=free |pmid=26196682 |pmc=4719419 |bibcode=2015PLoSO..1032277F }}</ref>
